description: Use when an agent needs to check a US-listed company. Returns a verdict line and the SEC facts behind it: going-concern language, delisting-notice 8-Ks, overdue reports, insider Form 4 direction. EDGAR down (503) or a foreign filer (404) is not charged. Costs 0.25 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

q.description: the company: a US-listed ticker such as AAPL, the company name as it is filed, or its website such as example.com (EDGAR rarely maps a website, so a website is matched by its domain to the company name and the answer says how)

site.description: optional: the company website to read with the site check (TLS, DNS, security headers), such as www.example.com; without it the site is the website given as q, or the one EDGAR lists

name: get_company_check

data.description: the get_company_check payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_company_check
